steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Dark matter makes up ~27% of the universe's mass-energy; it does not emit, absorb or reflect light | Key Fact: Evidence for dark matter: galaxy rotation curves (stars orbit faster than expected), gravitational lensing, galaxy cluster dynamics | Key Fact: Dark energy makes up ~68% of the universe's mass-energy; it drives the accelerating expansion | Key Fact: Ordinary (baryonic) matter makes up only ~5% of the universe

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from dark matter &amp; dark energy, and one past-paper question.
